title: Validation Result
description: Output of the post-execution validation step. Determines whether remediation succeeded, whether rollback is needed, and provides evidence links for the audit trail.

validation_id.description: Unique identifier for this validation run

time_window_seconds.description: How long the validator observed the service before concluding

check.description: Name of the check (e.g., slo_error_budget_ok, synthetic_checkout_pass)

detail.description: Human-readable detail about the check outcome

threshold.description: Threshold the metric was compared against

evidence_links.description: URIs to dashboards, traces, or metrics supporting the verdict

rollback_recommended.description: Whether the validator recommends triggering rollback
